steps: lua:if vcListCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-list-code-'..tostring(vcListCode)) end if type(vcHouses)~='table' or type(vcHouses[1])~='table' or not vcHouses[1][1] then error('vc10c-list-shape') end if type(vcFuncs)~='table' then error('vc10c-functions') end local open=false for _,id in ipairs(vcFuncs) do if tonumber(id)==71 then open=true end end if not open then error('vc10c-function-71') end if vcHouses[1][1].house_type~=xyd.DormType.LOUNGE then error('vc10c-house-type-'..tostring(vcHouses[1][1].house_type)) end if vcHouses[1][1].house_name~='' or vcHouses[1][1].is_hide~=0 or vcHouses[1][1].praise_num~=1 then error('vc10c-initial-social-'..tostring(vcHouses[1][1].praise_num)) end

lua:if vcNameCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-name-code-'..tostring(vcNameCode)) end if type(vcNameReply)~='table' then error('vc10c-name-reply') end vcDorm:getHouseList({}, function(code,reply) _G.vcListCode=code _G.vcHouses=reply.house_list end)

lua:if vcListCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-name-reload-code-'..tostring(vcListCode)) end if vcHouses[1][1].house_name~='vc10c' then error('vc10c-name-persist-'..tostring(vcHouses[1][1].house_name)) end

lua:if vcHideCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-hide-code-'..tostring(vcHideCode)) end if type(vcHideReply)~='table' or type(vcHideReply.house_info)~='table' then error('vc10c-hide-reply') end if vcHideReply.house_info.is_hide~=1 then error('vc10c-hide-value-'..tostring(vcHideReply.house_info.is_hide)) end vcDorm:getHouseList({}, function(code,reply) _G.vcListCode=code _G.vcHouses=reply.house_list end)

lua:if vcListCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-hide-reload-code-'..tostring(vcListCode)) end if vcHouses[1][1].is_hide~=1 then error('vc10c-hide-persist-'..tostring(vcHouses[1][1].is_hide)) end vcDorm:hideHouse({house_id=vcHouses[1][1].house_id}, function(code,reply) _G.vcHideCode=code _G.vcHideReply=reply end)

lua:if vcHideCode~=xyd.error.OK or vcHideReply.house_info.is_hide~=0 then error('vc10c-unhide-'..tostring(vcHideCode)) end vcDorm:getHouseList({}, function(code,reply) _G.vcListCode=code _G.vcHouses=reply.house_list end)

lua:if vcListCode~=xyd.error.OK or vcHouses[1][1].is_hide~=0 then error('vc10c-unhide-persist') end vcDorm:getPraiseList({house_id=vcHouses[1][1].house_id, start=0, offset=vcDorm.singlePageMsgNum}, function(code,reply) _G.vcPraiseCode=code _G.vcPraiseReply=reply end)

lua:if vcPraiseCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-praise-list-code-'..tostring(vcPraiseCode)) end if type(vcPraiseReply.praise_list)~='table' or type(vcPraiseReply.total_num)~='number' then error('vc10c-praise-list-shape') end if vcPraiseReply.total_num~=1 or #vcPraiseReply.praise_list~=1 then error('vc10c-praise-list-total-'..tostring(vcPraiseReply.total_num)) end local row=vcPraiseReply.praise_list[1] if type(row.player_info)~='table' or tonumber(row.player_info.player_id)==tonumber(vcDorm.selfPlayer.playerID) then error('vc10c-praise-actor') end

lua:if vcPraisePage2Code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-praise-page2-code-'..tostring(vcPraisePage2Code)) end if #vcPraisePage2.praise_list~=0 or vcPraisePage2.total_num~=1 then error('vc10c-praise-page2-'..tostring(#vcPraisePage2.praise_list)) end

lua:if vcCommentCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-comment-list-code-'..tostring(vcCommentCode)) end if type(vcCommentReply.best_comments)~='table' or type(vcCommentReply.comment_list)~='table' or type(vcCommentReply.comment_num)~='number' then error('vc10c-comment-list-shape') end if vcCommentReply.comment_num~=23 or #vcCommentReply.best_comments~=2 or #vcCommentReply.comment_list~=20 then error('vc10c-comment-page1-'..tostring(vcCommentReply.comment_num)..'-'..tostring(#vcCommentReply.best_comments)..'-'..tostring(#vcCommentReply.comment_list)) end for _,best in ipairs(vcCommentReply.best_comments) do if tonumber(best.praise_num)~=1 or tonumber(best.is_has_praise)~=0 then error('vc10c-comment-reaction-'..tostring(best.praise_num)) end end _G.vcDeleteID=nil for _,row in ipairs(vcCommentReply.comment_list) do if row.content=='vc-peer-comment-23' then _G.vcDeleteID=tonumber(row.comment_id) end end if not vcDeleteID then error('vc10c-comment-missing') end

lua:if vcCommentPage2Code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-comment-page2-code-'..tostring(vcCommentPage2Code)) end if vcCommentPage2.comment_num~=23 or #vcCommentPage2.comment_list~=1 then error('vc10c-comment-page2-'..tostring(vcCommentPage2.comment_num)..'-'..tostring(#vcCommentPage2.comment_list)) end

lua:if vcDeleteCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-delete-code-'..tostring(vcDeleteCode)) end vcDorm:getCommentList({house_id=vcHouses[1][1].house_id, start=0, offset=20}, function(code,reply) _G.vcCommentCode=code _G.vcCommentReply=reply end)

lua:if vcCommentCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc10c-delete-reload-code-'..tostring(vcCommentCode)) end if vcCommentReply.comment_num~=22 then error('vc10c-delete-total-'..tostring(vcCommentReply.comment_num)) end for _,row in ipairs(vcCommentReply.comment_list) do if row.content=='vc-peer-comment-23' then error('vc10c-delete-persist') end end

lua:if vcRandomCode==nil then error('vc10c-random-callback') end if vcRandomCode==xyd.error.OK then if type(vcRandomReply.house_infos)~='table' or type(vcRandomReply.host_info)~='table' or vcRandomReply.host_info.player_id==nil then error('vc10c-random-shape') end end
